rule.description: A parameter group of at least 3 identically named, identically typed values recurs across at least 3 function or method signatures spanning at least 2 files, with the members that recur in at least 2 signatures forming the recurring data group; the same group being forwarded as individual arguments at call sites is reported by the companion relation same-group-callsite-threading.

checks.description: Detect parameter groups that recur across function or method signatures spanning several files instead of being carried by one abstraction.
checks.detected_relation: signature <-> cluster of signatures sharing >= 3 identically named, identically typed parameters
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The identical values travel as unrelated individual parameters through every carrier, so each consumer must re-declare and re-order the whole group; the group recurred in at least 2 signatures to be counted as recurring and at least 3 carriers in at least 2 files to qualify as a clump.

matches.evidence: Reboot loop carrier in the command tier receives 23 parameters, 12 of which are members of the recurring group spanning the cluster's 4 signatures in 2 files.

Node drain operation takes 10 parameters whose names and types repeat the group members consumed by the drain: client, labels, delay, grace period, selector, delete timeout, drain timeout, notification URL and drain template.
Post-reboot uncordon operation repeats client, node, node name, post-reboot labels, notification URL and uncordon template from the same group.
Plain uncordon operation repeats client, node and post-reboot labels from the same group, re-deriving the rest of the lifecycle context at its own boundary.

checks.description: Detect call expressions that forward at least 6 members of a recurring parameter group as individual arguments.
checks.detected_relation: call expression -> carrier of the recurring parameter group
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The same conceptual data group is being manually threaded hop by hop through the call chain: every caller must enumerate the members positionally, which is how the clump propagates to new code.

matches.evidence: The goroutine launch of the reboot loop in main enumerates 12 recurring group members as individual arguments.
Loop-tick call to the post-reboot uncordon operation forwards 6 recurring members (client, node, node name, post-reboot labels, notification URL, uncordon template) as individual arguments.

Loop-tick call to the drain operation forwards 10 recurring members (client, node, pre-reboot labels, delay, grace period, selector, delete timeout, drain timeout, notification URL, drain template) as individual arguments.

excluded.reason: One-shot constructor assembling the distributed lock once at startup; its parameters are assembled once and never travel together again.
Recurring client and node name core lives in one file in a single grouping role; it is consumed by the reboot loop but is not part of the recurring lifecycle settings group.
Annotation and label patching helpers keep below the recurring-group threshold: their parameters extend at most 2 shared members into any other signature.
Flag-contract wiring and URL validation remain single-purpose; the flag variables stay as the configuration surface.
